outcome: Counts of Firmicutes and Bacteroidetes phyla organisms
cohort: Children between 5 and 11 years old living in an urban area in Brazil
finding: Important differences were observed between the gut microbiota of children living under distinct socioeconomic and environmental conditions within the same city.
mod_finding: The children in the private school group had higher rates of cesarean delivery and premature birth than the children in the slum group.
